name: Seeing Red
source:
Your first breath is shallow, your thoughts foggy. Just as your mouth opens to ask where you are, the door swings wide and a detective enters, not surprised to see you awake.

[From [url=https://shakethatdanicake.itch.io/seeing-red]Itch.io[/url]]
